plain_text:
Robert Young appears in 66 recordings across 6 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1944 to 1957. The credits here include performer.

In this archive, you will hear Robert Young most often in Father Knows Best, Lux Radio Theatre, CBS Radio Workshop, Encore Theater, Fibber McGee and Molly, and Old Gold Comedy Theater.

Characters credited here include Jim Anderson.
